mapper.select: SELECT setting_key AS "settingKey", setting_value AS "settingValue", target_year AS "targetYear" FROM system_setting WHERE setting_key IN ( 'SESSION_IDLE_MINUTES', 'PAGE_SIZE', 'DEFAULT_SEARCH_PERIOD_DAYS', 'BULK_QUERY_THRESHOLD', 'LONG_RUNNING_WORK_NOTICE_SECONDS' )

SELECT setting_key AS "settingKey", setting_value AS "settingValue", target_year AS "targetYear" FROM system_setting WHERE setting_key IN ( 'CURRENT_EVALUATION_YEAR', 'DEFAULT_SEARCH_YEAR', 'REFERENCE_DATA_COPY_YN', 'INITIALIZATION_YN' )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_setting (setting_key, setting_value, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{settingKey}, #{settingValue}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId}) ON CONFLICT (setting_key) DO UPDATE SET setting_value = EXCLUDED.setting_value, updated_at = current_timestamp, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by

INSERT INTO system_setting (setting_key, setting_value, target_year, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{settingKey}, #{settingValue}, #{targetYear}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId}) ON CONFLICT (setting_key) DO UPDATE SET setting_value = EXCLUDED.setting_value, target_year = EXCLUDED.target_year, updated_at = current_timestamp, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
